expectations.text: The firmware detects gestures in software from the IMU (M5.Imu / MPU6886 accelerometer), since the MPU6886 has no on-chip gesture engine
The swing (slash) detector requires acceleration above a threshold for a minimum duration or uses a lockout, so a tap knock is not counted as a slash
expectations.evidence: gyro peak > 350 dps with re-arm below 120 dps and 250 ms min gap (lockout)

expectations.text: Lay-flat detection uses hysteresis (separate on/off thresholds) or a hold time, and the event is sent only on state change
expectations.evidence: FLAT_HOLD_MS 1000 still hold; PAUSE/RESUME sent on change

expectations.text: The firmware sends small named event packets (event id + code) over a BLE notify characteristic rather than streaming raw sensor data
expectations.evidence: short text notifications SLASH/SPECIAL/PAUSE, not raw data

expectations.text: Advertising puts the custom service UUID in the advertising data so the browser can filter by it
expectations.evidence: Advertises only the name (Nordic UART UUIDs not in advertising data)

expectations.text: The web page connects with navigator.bluetooth.requestDevice filtered by the service UUID and subscribes to notifications
expectations.evidence: requestDevice filters by namePrefix StickSword, not service UUID

expectations.text: The web game has a keyboard mode that triggers the same events (slash, pause/flat, special attack) through the same handler as BLE
expectations.evidence: simulator: Space/S slash, D special, P flat, sends same messages

expectations.text: The answer tells the user which Arduino board and libraries to select (M5StickCPlus2 board, M5Unified) and that Web Bluetooth needs Chrome/Edge over HTTPS or localhost
